content.prompt: Assess the current experiment for the research committee using the available source record. Report the admissible result and defensible research status, including whether deployment is supported.
content.required_final_keys_note: Include all four top-level keys: question_id, integer turn, answers and evidence, even for single-turn cases. Replace every placeholder; this template contains no financial answer.

response_contract.evidence: For each field, a list of IDs of viewed supporting documents. Each field must have its own sufficient support; references elsewhere do not carry over. Valid alternative sufficient routes and relevant corroboration accepted. Numeric tolerance1e-6 absolute+1e-8 relative.

sources.text: All returns are percentage points per trade; arithmetic means apply. Decisions occur at 09:00. A feature is admissible only if its availability timestamp is strictly before 09:00. Use only admissible trades. Familywise significance requires Bonferroni p <= 0.05 / number of tried pipelines, including discarded pipelines. A significant validation result permits only a provisional research claim. Deployment also requires positive executable mean net return and a prospectively evaluated untouched holdout. A failed criterion means status reject; otherwise status provisional until holdout passes. Never select a model using holdout outcomes.
sources.title: Research governance

sources.text: The audit owns these aggregates for disjoint trade groups: A has 40 trades, sum of gross returns 64 percentage points, feature available 08:50; B has 20 trades, sum 56 percentage points, available 08:58; C has 40 trades, sum 160 percentage points, available 09:02. Audit p-values for the prespecified test are 0.004 on A+B and 0.009 on A alone. No test p-value can be reconstructed from sums alone; use these audited p-values. Initial trial register contains one pipeline. No executable cost estimate or holdout result has been released.
sources.title: Initial timestamp and sample audit
